prompt: Who was the first woman to serve on the executive committee of the International Union of Geological Sciences?
answer: The first woman to serve on the executive committee of the International Union of Geological Sciences was **Zofia Kielan-Jaworowska**, a Polish paleobiologist. She served as a vice president from **1980 to 1989**.
